item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena's teacher asks the class to group objects by a common property. Which statement about grouping objects is not correct?

options.A: A steel spoon, a steel plate and an iron nail can be grouped together because they are all made of metal.
options.B: Grouping objects always means putting any objects together, even when no common property is used.
options.C: A red ball, a red pencil and a red eraser can be grouped together because they share the same colour.
options.D: A cotton shirt, a woollen cap and a silk scarf can be grouped together because they are all made of fabric.
